items.title: Apple adds more Siri AI tools in its 27.2 system updates, out today
items.summary: Apple has released system updates across its platforms that include new Siri AI capabilities. These updates are available to users starting today.
items.blurb: Apple has rolled out software updates for all its platforms today.

items.title: Uh oh, it sounds like the iPhone Duo keeps cracking and users aren’t happy about it
items.summary: Early users of Apple's new foldable iPhone Duo are reporting instances of the screen cracking. This has led to dissatisfaction among the device's early adopters.
items.blurb: A small number of early adopters of the much hyped new foldable phone from Apple have complained of screens cracking.

items.title: Ghost of Yōtei studio Sucker Punch reportedly lays off 24 workers
items.summary: Sucker Punch, the studio behind the recently released expansion for Ghost of Yōtei, has reportedly laid off 24 employees. This news comes shortly after the success of their latest project.
items.blurb: Developer Sucker Punch just released a well-received expansion for Ghost of Yōtei a few weeks ago.

items.title: Fusion startups are giving the government shares in exchange for awards. Is it worth it?
items.summary: Fusion startups are being asked by the government to provide equity in exchange for funding awards. The industry is currently evaluating whether this trade-off is beneficial.
items.blurb: Fusion startups face a new challenge, one unrelated to plasma physics: Give the government shares in exchange for funding awards or go it alone?

items.title: Apple responds to reports of the iPhone Duo's inner display cracking
items.summary: Apple has issued a response regarding reports of cracked inner displays on the new iPhone Duo. Impacted customers are advised to contact AppleCare for potential device replacements.
items.blurb: Impacted users can contact AppleCare for a replacement.

items.title: iPhone Duo now supports Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2
items.summary: The iOS 27.2 update introduces Apple Pencil support for the iPhone Duo and adds a new Edge Light feature for video calls. This fulfills the company's previous promise to bring stylus support to the device this year.
items.blurb: Apple has just released iOS 27.2, bringing Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo. The software update also includes an "Edge Light" feature for the iPhone Duo that's intended to illuminate your face during video calls. Apple previously said the iPhone Duo would add support for the Apple Pencil "later this year." The company's first […]

items.title: Your Apple TV remote has handy shortcuts most people never use
items.summary: The Apple TV remote includes several hidden shortcuts designed to improve navigation. Learning these functions can make managing menus much easier for users.
items.blurb: Getting to know your remote a little better makes it a lot easier to navigate the Apple TV menus.

items.title: The NBA’s response to gambling scandals is to add more gambling partnerships
items.summary: Despite ongoing gambling controversies, the NBA has announced new partnership deals with prediction market platforms Kalshi and Polymarket. This move continues the league's association with betting-related services.
items.blurb: From the bright minds that brought you FTX Arena and NBA Top Shot NFT maketplace (where sales last month dropped to $762,781, which is a 99.66 percent decrease compared to the February 2021 peak of $226,350,843), the NBA announced Monday that it has new "preferred" prediction market deals for Kalshi and Polymarket, as well as […]

items.title: How to use your Samsung Galaxy phone to wirelessly charge other devices
items.summary: Many newer Samsung Galaxy smartphones feature the ability to wirelessly charge other devices. This feature serves as a convenient power source for users in need.
items.blurb: If you're in desperate need of power, lots of newer Samsung phones can wirelessly charge other devices.

items.title: This startup’s self-driving excavators help dig up $600M in new funding
items.summary: Bedrock Robotics has secured $600 million in funding, bringing its valuation to $4.1 billion. The company aims to address the shortage of skilled operators through its autonomous excavators.
items.blurb: Bedrock Robotics, which is now valued at $4.1 billion, is particularly focused on autonomous excavators, in part because of a growing shortage of skilled operators.

items.title: Instagram wants you to watch 90-minute videos on your TV
items.summary: Instagram is exploring long-form content by experimenting with 90-minute videos. These videos are specifically intended to be viewed on television sets.
items.blurb: Instagram is experimenting with longform video again.

items.title: The RealReal won’t let AI agents hog designer clothing
items.summary: The RealReal is upgrading its bot defense system to prevent AI agents from reserving designer items. The decision follows reports that AI tools were being used to manipulate the site's reservation system.
items.blurb: The RealReal, a secondhand luxury fashion consignment retailer, said it's updating its bot defense system, effectively making it harder for AI agents to shop on its site. The change comes days after The Verge reported that an AI agent could be used to take advantage of The RealReal's item reserve system. On the retailer's website, […]

items.title: Apple acknowledges iPhone Duo display ‘issue’ after reports of cracked screens
items.summary: Apple has officially acknowledged a display issue affecting a small number of iPhone Duo units. The problem, which manifests as a bright line on the screen, is currently being addressed by the company.
items.blurb: Following reports of iPhone Duos with cracked and broken inside screens, often showing a bright line running from the center to the right side, Apple says in a statement to Bloomberg and 9to5Mac that it's aware of "an issue impacting the inner display" on a "small number of iPhone Duo units." items.title: Nothing’s eye-catching Ear 3A earbuds are matching their best price to date
items.summary: Nothing's Ear 3A wireless earbuds are currently on sale for $79 across several major retailers. The price drop matches the lowest point for these noise-canceling earbuds.
items.blurb: If you want a decent pair of noise-canceling earbuds without spending a fortune, Nothing’s Ear 3A are worth considering. items.title: Dutch government to cut 16 percent of workforce as part of AI efficiency push
items.summary: The Dutch government plans to reduce its workforce by 16 percent by 2035. This initiative is part of a broader strategy to increase efficiency through the use of AI.
items.blurb: The cabinet announced that it wants to get rid of 25,000 full-time jobs by 2035.

items.title: Five weird details from Anthropic’s IPO filing
items.summary: Anthropic has filed its S-1 prospectus for an upcoming IPO. The document provides investors with detailed information on executive compensation, financial strategy, and potential business risks.
items.blurb: Anthropic has finally filed its S-1 prospectus with the SEC, a document designed to give investors a look under the hood of its business, from how much its executives are making and plans for spending its IPO billions to the risks that could derail its ambitions. items.title: Microsoft reportedly offers voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees as an attempt to trim costs
items.summary: Microsoft is reportedly offering voluntary buyouts to 60,000 employees in a move to reduce operational costs. This figure represents over one-quarter of the company's total global workforce.
items.blurb: That's over a quarter of the company's global workforce.

items.title: Everything old is new again with the Fitbit Edge
items.summary: The Fitbit Edge is making a return to the market, evoking a sense of nostalgia. The device aims to provide a familiar experience for users interested in wearable trackers.
items.blurb: Last week, I sank into my living room couch and watched a bedraggled, nihilistic Matthew McConaughey take a drag of a cigarette in season 1 of True Detective. items.title: Fitbit Edge review: Google strikes the right balance
items.summary: The Fitbit Edge is being positioned as a balanced choice for users who want a high-quality tracker without AI integration. It is noted for its beautiful display and focused functionality.
items.blurb: Want a beautiful tracker with a screen but don't want AI on your wrist? The Fitbit Edge is perfect for you.

items.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
items.summary: Anthropic's IPO filing highlights a successful cross-selling strategy that encourages enterprise customers to use both the Claude Platform and first-party applications. This approach has helped the company increase customer retention and loyalty.
items.blurb: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.
